```{r}
#| message: false
#| echo: false
classes <- c(
  as.Date("2026-07-19") + lubridate::ddays(0:4)
) |>
  sort()

i <- 0
echo_date <- function(...) {
  i <<- i + 1
  x <- classes[i] |>
    format("%a, %b %e")
  htmltools::div(
    class = "card-header",
    "data-date" = classes[i],
    htmltools::h4(paste(i, ".", x, ...))
  )
}

topic <- function() {
  paste(fontawesome::fa("lightbulb"), "Topic:")
}
slides <- function() {
  paste(fontawesome::fa("microphone"), "Speaker:")
}
discuss <- function() {
  paste(fontawesome::fa("comment"), "Discussion:")
}
eat <- function() {
  paste(fontawesome::fa("utensils"), "Meal:")
}
```


## Pre-workshop Homework

- **Watch**:   
  "y code when ai?"  
  [Hadley Wickham](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hadley_Wickham), Chief Scientist, Posit  
  (~ 45 minutes): In this webinar, Hadley Wickham illustrates how he uses AI to do most of his actual coding work these days. 
  
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/oi5mopOO4_Y?si=sJdVgw8f4UxqbrsG" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" allowfullscreen></iframe>

- **Read**:
    - In the popular press:
        - @stanford2023: Review of an AI Summit at Stanford. 
        - @walsh2025everyone: An investigate piece from *New York Magazine* detailing the use of generative AI tools by college students. 
        - @shirky2025students: An editorial by the vice provost at NYU advocating a return to oral and in-person assessment methods. 
        - @oberlinluddite2025luddite: An editorial written by students at Oberlin College asking their president to "terminate the College’s contract with Google Gemini and OpenAI".
    - Scholarly papers:
        - `r emoji::emoji("eight-pointed-star")` @deluca2025developing: An article showing that while generative AI is able to complete statistics assignments to a reasonable degree, there are detectable differences in the use of language across different LLMs and groups of people.  
          **Note**: [Sunday's plenary speaker](schedule.qmd#workshop-schedule) Alex Reinhart is a co-author on this paper! 
        - @daniotti2026using: An article in *Science* showing that while generative AI tools help more experienced programmers improve their productivity, the same gains are not observed among entry-level developers. 
        - @bien2025generative: A reflection on having students code with GitHub Copilot in a data science MBA course. 
        - @fernandes2025ai: A study showing that while performance on the LSAT improved with AI use, metacognitive accuracy declined. 

There are many, many more things to read on [our reading list](reading.qmd)!
